_about: Public-domain J. W. Burgon (John William Burgon, 1813-1888, Dean of Chichester, defender of the Traditional Text) for the Word Hoard: Inspiration and Interpretation (1861) and The Last Twelve Verses of S. Mark (1871) from CCEL; The Traditional Text of the Holy Gospels and The Causes of the Corruption of the Traditional Text (both 1896, arranged and edited after his death by Edward Miller) from Project Gutenberg; and from Internet Archive scans A Treatise on the Pastoral Office (1864), Mr. Sandford and the University Sermon (1865), England and Rome (1869), The Servants of Scripture (1878), The Disestablishment of Religion in Oxford (1880), The Revision Revised (first edition, 1883) and The First Chapter of Genesis (undated). Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 21 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
